It's from the anime and light novel series **Durarara!!**.

The character speaking is the manipulative information broker, **Izaya Orihara**. He's explaining to his friend, Shinra Kishitani, how he gathers so much personal information on people.

This line perfectly encapsulates Izaya's character: he doesn't always have to steal information; he's so skilled at manipulation that people willingly give it to him, believing they can trust the online personas he creates. It's a chillingly accurate commentary on online privacy and a perfect summary of his methods.
